comparison.objective: Reorient a baby bottle mouth-down and hang it over a drying peg; the candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Quarter-turn reorientation and blind peg insertion, not screw/nut torque coordination.
comparison.success_condition: Peg enters at least 3 cm, bottle hangs released and still with clearance for 1 s; candidate grades angle setting and functional retention.
comparison.reason: No shared adjustable-lock mechanism exists in either available version.
